items.title: Will PayPal’s (PYPL) Profit Beat and Takeover Buzz Reshape Its Turnaround Narrative?
items.summary: In the past week, PayPal Holdings, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results showing revenue of US$8.68 billion versus US$8.29 billion a year earlier, while net income and GAAP earnings per share edged lower year on year. Despite this, PayPal’s adjusted earnings beat analyst expectations, management raised full-year profit guidance, and the company highlighted progress on its cost-savings and turnaround plan amid ongoing takeover interest from Stripe and Advent International.
